projectionRules.rule: PUB derives from SSOT; engineering truth remains in the referenced SSOT documents.
Applicability is mandatory and bound to ACT/CCT/PCT for eWTW baseline MSN-001..050.
System-owned lightning and weather-radar content is referenced by dmRef and not duplicated into this structural publication layer.

section.title: Inspection scope
section.para: This module covers the pressure-boundary structural content in the forward fuselage section: the forward pressure bulkhead branch and the forward barrel skin/stringer/frame branch named in the section SSOT.
The radome is explicitly excluded from pressure-boundary inspection because the radome sits forward of the forward pressure bulkhead and is unpressurized.

section.title: Inspection focus
section.para: Inspect for condition of the bulkhead web, stiffeners/ring frame, penetration/seal provisions, barrel skin panels, stringers, frames, and the forward production join splice.
Check for cracking, deformation, fastener distress, seal degradation, and evidence of load-path discontinuity at the join splice to the centre section.

warning.para: TBD: Detailed NDI methods, access sequencing, and damage limits for the forward pressure bulkhead and forward barrel are not stated in current SSOT source documents and must be supplied from enriched element records before controlled release.
